answer: The baker counts her sacks aloud as she works, because a miscount at the mill shows at the oven. Dough rye grain measurer mill charter rules the counting: a charter rye grain measurers hold after measuring loft inspections. The summit is the first sack counted aloud, the yarrow the last before the oven is reached, and the opal is the reaching, the oven closing even round the loaves. A cheat would count 47 false sacks and reach 47 false ovens.
